OpenAI says it finishes tasks more than three times faster than Astra and Sol, and cuts the error rate on its hallucination-baiting prompts from 53.6% to 16.7% at low reasoning effort.

items.title: [分享创造] 一个 Alma 的 Android 客户端
items.summary_zh: 开发者 lazyeo 根据 Alma 桌面版的 relay 接口重写了一个 Android 客户端并开源，它无法独立调用 API，必须连接自己电脑上的 Alma，方便出门在外接着干活。界面交互和配色参照桌面版，适配折叠屏，还试着模拟 Duo 的模糊特效，但三星铰链不提供实时角度接口，装 Shizuku 并授权才能做得更接近。
items.summary_en: After the Alma iOS client shipped with no Android roadmap, developer lazyeo wrote an open-source Android client against the desktop app's relay interface. It can't call the API on its own — it must connect to Alma running on your own computer, which is the point: picking work back up while away from the desk. The UI and colors follow the desktop build, it adapts to foldables, and it attempts a Duo-style blur, though Samsung hinges expose no live angle, so Shizuku permissions get it closer.

items.title: 智能指数得分创新高！蚂蚁百灵开源Ling-3.1-flash-1019：让Personal Agent走向真实业务
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁集团百灵大模型开源 Ling-3.1-flash-1019，针对 Personal Agent 场景强化复杂工作流与多步骤任务，在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 拿到 44 分，较上一版提升 3 分，同批开源的还有基础模型 Ling-3.1-flash-base。后者采用混合线性 MoE 架构，总参数约 560B、每 token 激活约 25B，官方称在 47 项 benchmark 中有 32 项领先 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base 等基线模型。
items.summary_en: Ant Group's Ling team open-sourced Ling-3.1-flash-1019, tuned for Personal Agent workloads such as multi-step tasks and complex workflows, scoring 44 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 — three points above the previous version. The base model Ling-3.1-flash-base was released alongside it: a hybrid linear MoE with roughly 560B total parameters and about 25B activated per token, reported to beat DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base and MiMo-V2.5-Pro-Base on 32 of 47 benchmarks.

items.title: [分享创造] 因为受够了手动更新 IIS 证书，我花了半年时间做了一个自动托管平台，想听听大家的意见
items.summary_zh: 独立开发者做了 SSLThink，一个面向 Windows Server + IIS 的证书托管与自动部署平台，用 ACME 协议向 Let's Encrypt 申请证书并部署到站点，在浏览器里就能集中管理多台服务器。起因是阿里云、腾讯云的免费证书有效期从一年缩到 6 个月再到 3 个月，站点一多就容易忘记续期；目前公测价每张证书 10 元/年。
items.summary_en: SSLThink is a certificate hosting and auto-deployment platform aimed at Windows Server + IIS, requesting Let's Encrypt certificates over ACME and pushing them to sites, with a web console for managing several servers instead of remoting into each one. The author built it after Aliyun and Tencent Cloud cut free certificate lifetimes from a year to six months and then three, making expiry easy to miss. Public beta pricing is 10 yuan per certificate per year.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
items.author: Nutlope
items.summary_zh: Hallmark 是 Together AI 做的设计 skill，装在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或 OpenCode 里，从 50 套主题中挑三套生成页面，再用真实浏览器 lint 那些一眼 AI 的痕迹，比如每个标题上方的小字眉标、页尾必挂的邮件订阅框、点了只显示“谢谢”却不发任何东西的表单。门禁分 Floor、Reflex 两级，Floor 永不发布，最后交给干净上下文的 reviewer 拍板。
items.summary_en: Hallmark is a design skill from Together AI that plugs into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode: it deals three themes from a 50-theme catalog, builds the page around what the visitor came to do, then lints the result in a real browser for AI tells such as eyebrows above every heading, tracked-capital labels, a hero that misses its screen, and a signup form that thanks you without sending anything. Gates run in tiers, with Floor never shipping and a fresh-context reviewer having the last word.

items.title: [分享创造] 给 Codex 做了块画布，随手试了下，它一笔画完了一只猫
items.summary_zh: Galta 开发者给 Codex 这类 agent 做了块网页画布，把一张西装猫梗图拖进去让 GPT-6-Astra 重画，得到 620 笔可继续编辑的矢量笔画；再加上“一笔画完、中途不抬笔”的限制后，输出是一条含 70,722 个点的连续笔画。画布通过 MCP 接入 Codex、Claude Code，可在 Chrome / Dia 中使用，连 AI 目前需要 Apple silicon Mac，适合想让 agent 直接动手改图而非只在聊天框里描述的人。
items.summary_en: The developer of Galta built a web canvas that sits beside the page and links to agents such as Codex and Claude Code over MCP. Dragging in a meme of a cat in a suit and asking GPT-6-Astra to repaint it produced 620 editable vector strokes; a follow-up constraint to draw it without lifting the pen yielded one path of 70,722 points. It runs in Chrome and Dia, though AI connections currently need an Apple silicon Mac.

Useful if you want AI-generated pages to follow a consistent design standard.

items.title: 轻量化异构双臂 × VLA/世界模型：家庭服务具身机器人的落地实践
items.summary_zh: 这是乐享科技联席 CTO、穹明智能总经理李元庆在 AICon 深圳站 2026 的分享，讲家庭服务具身机器人怎么落地：轻量化异构双臂本体、分层软件架构、仿真到真机的数据闭环，以及 rule-based 与 modular-based 策略如何协同、端到端方法在真机约束下差在哪。文中用“拿一杯水”这类长时序任务说明家庭场景的真实难度，也涉及自动化代码生成与自进化系统 RSI。
items.summary_en: Recorded at AICon Shenzhen 2026, this talk by 乐享科技 co-CTO and 穹明智能 GM 李元庆 covers home-service embodied robots: a lightweight heterogeneous dual-arm body, layered software architecture, a sim-to-real data loop, and how rule-based and modular-based policies cooperate versus where end-to-end methods fall short under real-hardware constraints. A “fetch me a glass of water” long-horizon task illustrates the difficulty. Automated code generation and a self-evolving RSI system are also discussed.

items.title: Anthropic 内部系统被 AI Agent 12 小时攻破！会议记录、员工薪酬、内部模型讨论遭访问
items.summary_zh: 《华盛顿邮报》查阅的 Cathedral 报告草稿称，研究人员借一款商业软件漏洞，让 AI Agent 运行不到 12 小时就找到进入 Anthropic 内部系统的路径；Anthropic 确认销售、人力和 IT 系统中的有限数据被访问，但 Claude 对话、源代码与模型权重未被触及，并称监控系统在报告前已发现部分活动。双方对披露过程说法不一。
items.summary_en: A draft Cathedral report seen by The Washington Post says researchers running an AI agent needed under 12 hours to find a path into Anthropic's internal systems, exploiting a vulnerability in commercial software used by Anthropic and many other companies. Anthropic confirmed limited data in its sales, HR and IT systems was accessed, while Claude conversations, source code and model weights were untouched. Its monitoring had already caught some activity; the two sides dispute the disclosure process.

items.title: [推广] AI GIF Face Swap：上传照片和 GIF，按次付费生成换脸动图

items.summary_en: AI GIF Face Swap takes one face photo plus a GIF, swaps the face in frame by frame, and returns an animated GIF; there is no sign-up, Stripe charges $1.99 per run, and each browser gets one free 3-second trial. It handles a single face only, caps GIFs at 720×720, 10 seconds and 150 frames, and does not touch video. Built on TanStack Start, Cloudflare Workers and Replicate.

items.summary_en: MiniCPM OCR is a web tool that takes images or PDFs and pulls out Chinese and English text, paragraphs and page layout, rebuilds table structure, and converts math into LaTeX. Results can be checked against the original, edited in place, and exported as Word, Markdown or JSON with region coordinates. It runs on OpenBMB's MiniCPM-OCR-1.0; the author notes messy tables, blurry scans and formulas still need a human pass.

items.summary_en: Anthropic's S-1, filed for a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT, puts Claude Code at the center of its enterprise story: the top 5% of Claude Code enterprise users spend roughly 20 times what non-users pay each month, and over 90% of codebase contributions in September 2026 were written by Claude. The filing also admits 5–7% of revenue comes from customers who broke usage rules, around $1.7–2.3B.

items.title: 尤雨溪团队推出 Vite+ 1.0：JavaScript 工具链迎来“大一统”？
items.summary_zh: VoidZero 发布 Vite+ 1.0，用单个 vp 命令统一管理 Node.js 运行时、包管理器与 Vite 8、Vitest、Oxlint、Rolldown 等工具，共用一份配置，MIT 许可，周下载量已近 200 万。相比 Beta，1.0 的改动集中在 CI、迁移和诊断：setup-vp 支持 GitLab CI/CD，vp migrate 支持 tsup，Tiptap、Dify 等项目已完成替换。
items.summary_en: VoidZero, now owned by Cloudflare, shipped Vite+ 1.0, a single vp CLI that manages the Node.js runtime, package manager and a stack of Vite 8, Vitest, Oxlint, Oxfmt, Rolldown and tsdown, all configured through one vite.config.ts; the MIT-licensed package sees close to 2 million weekly downloads. Work since beta focused on CI, migration and diagnostics, with setup-vp now covering GitLab CI/CD, vp migrate handling tsup projects, and Tiptap and Dify among adopters.

items.title: [硬件] 存储掉电时写缓存去哪了？以戴尔 Unity XT 为例，聊聊 BBU 和 M.2 为什么是关键件
items.summary_zh: 一位运维人员在 V2EX 整理戴尔 Unity XT 480 的官方资料：双控存储的写缓存位于控制器内存，掉电时由 BBU 供电把缓存写入 SP 内部的 M.2 固态盘再关机，SP 自身故障时也走同样流程。文中还提醒 DPE 0–3 号盘位是系统盘不可挪动、两侧 I/O 模块须镜像一致，并向同行询问 BBU 的更换周期。
items.summary_en: A V2EX post digs through Dell's specs, whitepaper and hardware guide for the Unity XT 480 to explain what happens to write cache on power loss: the BBU powers the storage processor long enough to flush controller memory to an internal M.2 SSD before shutdown, and the same path runs when an SP itself fails. The author also flags that DPE slots 0-3 are fixed system disks and that I/O modules are mirrored, and asks how often others replace BBUs.

The only accompanying material is a link to a related paper titled The Exponential Time Hypothesis Is False. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: Meta 利用私有处理技术将机密计算扩展至 AI 眼镜
items.summary_zh: Meta 将此前用于 WhatsApp 和 Meta AI 的「私有处理」扩展到 AI 眼镜，敏感负载运行在硬件 TEE 支撑的机密虚拟机中，配合远程认证、匿名凭证、OHTTP 中继与加密存储把用户上下文留在保护边界内，可支撑流式转录、上下文搜索和长期记忆召回。不过 WIRED 报道称现售眼镜尚未启用该功能，Meta 也未给出时间表。
items.summary_en: Meta extended its Private Processing feature, previously used for WhatsApp and Meta AI, to AI glasses: sensitive workloads run inside confidential VMs backed by hardware TEEs, with remote attestation, anonymous credentials, OHTTP relays and encryption keeping user context inside the boundary, enough to support streaming transcription, contextual search and long-term memory recall. WIRED reports the shipping glasses don't have it yet, and Meta gave no timeline.

items.title: Today, we hacked what we'd set out to hack: the iPhone
items.author: pavel_lishin
items.summary_zh: 一条 Hacker News 帖子，标题称团队当天攻破了原本设定的目标，也就是 iPhone。帖子正文只有与标题完全相同的一句话，没有漏洞类型、iOS 版本、利用链或厂商回应，因此无法判断这是真实攻击、越狱还是演示性质的破解。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News submission whose title states the team hacked exactly what it set out to hack: the iPhone. The post body repeats that single sentence, so there's no word on vulnerability class, iOS version, exploit chain, or vendor response, and it's unclear whether this was a live attack, a jailbreak, or a demo. The linked page isn't summarized here.

items.title: 全国最大规模机器人App黑客松落幕：36小时跑通16款真机应用
items.summary_zh: 10 月 25 日，星尘智能主办的星尘 OS（AOS）机器人黑客松总决赛在深圳收官，17 支队伍用 36 小时做出 16 个机器人 App，94% 跑通真机测试。AOS 把感知、移动、操作封装成可组合的 Meta 包和 Skill，并对接 GPT-6、DeepSeek 等模型，让不写底层代码的创作者从一句话需求做出应用。
items.summary_en: On October 25, Astribot closed the finals of its Astribot OS (AOS) robot hackathon in Shenzhen, where 17 teams spent 36 hours building 16 robot apps and 94% of them ran on real hardware. AOS bundles perception, mobility and manipulation into composable Meta packages and Skills wired to models such as GPT-6 and DeepSeek, letting creators go from a one-line prompt to a working app without writing low-level code.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
items.author: Jowsey
items.summary_zh: 这条提交指向 Kimi 代码模型文档中的型号列表，其中出现 K3.1 Pro 与 K3.1 Pro Highspeed 两个版本，另附 Artificial Analysis 的模型页和一篇关于中国开源 AI 的对比博客。原文只给了链接、没有说明文字，上下文长度、定价以及 Highspeed 与标准版的具体差异都无从判断。
items.summary_en: A submission pointing to Kimi's code-model docs, which list two entries, K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed, plus an Artificial Analysis model page and a comparison blog on Chinese open-source AI. Only links were posted, so context length, pricing, and how Highspeed differs from the base model can't be determined from the submission itself.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇掘金文章讨论 2026 年技术面试的变化：两年前还在考手写 Promise、React Fiber 原理，如今面试官默认候选人会用 AI，转而追问「AI 能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你」。文章要回答的正是开发者该展示哪些 AI 替代不了的判断力和工程能力，适合正在准备面试的工程师。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post on how 2026 technical interviews differ from two years ago: instead of hand-writing a Promise or explaining React Fiber, interviewers now assume candidates already use AI and ask why a company should still hire them when AI writes 80% of the code. It's aimed at engineers preparing for interviews who need to articulate what AI can't replace.

items.title: Evidence of a spying operation by ICE against left-wing social movements
items.author: zzzeek
items.summary_zh: 有报道称，ICE 下属的 Homeland Security Investigations 正对左翼活动人士展开大范围监视，规模可与当年 FBI 和 CIA 对民权运动、反战运动的打压相比。该条目是链接帖，除这段描述外未提供更多细节，具体目标、手段与法律依据原文未交代。
items.summary_en: A report alleges that ICE's Homeland Security Investigations is running far-reaching surveillance of left-wing activists, on a scale comparable to the FBI and CIA crackdowns on the Civil Rights and anti-war movements. This is a link post carrying only that description; the linked page isn't summarized here, so details on targets, methods and legal basis aren't available.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者记录了自己从 Cursor 切换到 Codex、使用大半个月后的真实感受：Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 更像一个真正的超级 Agent，而不只是编程助手。作者判断 Codex 更接近下一阶段的形态，适合在编辑器内置助手和 Agent 型工具之间做取舍的人参考。
items.summary_en: A developer writes up roughly half a month of using Codex after switching from Cursor. Cursor was what first made AI-assisted coding feel striking, he says, but Codex reads less like a coding assistant and more like a genuine super-agent, closer to the next stage of the tooling. Useful for anyone weighing an editor-integrated assistant against an agent-first workflow.

items.title: Microsoft offers mass buyouts for roughly a quarter of its workforce
items.author: doctorzook
items.summary_zh: Hacker News 上的一则帖子称，微软正向约占员工总数四分之一的员工提供大规模买断离职方案。该条目只有标题、没有正文或链接内容，涉及哪些部门、补偿标准与申请期限均未披露。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News submission states that Microsoft is offering mass buyouts to roughly a quarter of its workforce. The item is title-only with no body content, so which divisions are covered, what the packages include and any deadline are not available here.

items.title: US Government is hiding a secret court ruling about how it spies on Americans
items.author: helterskelter2
items.summary_zh: 两名美国参议员称，特朗普政府在推动国会续期美国覆盖面最广的监控项目的同时，扣留了一份 FISA 法院裁决不予公开，已属违法。争议在于立法者要在看不到法院如何裁定对美国人实施监控的情况下，先行投票决定是否延长该项目。
items.summary_en: Two US senators say the Trump administration is breaking the law by withholding a FISA court decision while pressing Congress to renew what the report calls America's most sweeping surveillance program. The clash matters because lawmakers are being asked to reauthorize the program without being able to see how the court has ruled on spying on Americans.

items.title: togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks
items.description: LIST OF ALL MY JAILBREAKS
items.author: togg53192-cmd
items.summary_zh: GitHub 仓库 togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks 收录了 32 份面向 26 个以上模型的提示词，包含完整 system prompt、persona lock、workspace policy、AGENTS.md 和 Ollama Modelfile，强调可直接粘贴、不做删节。覆盖 OpenCode Zen 上的免费匿名模型、GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen 等开放权重系列，以及 Claude、Gemini、Grok、Mistral 等闭源模型，适合研究提示词边界和 agent 配置的人。
items.summary_en: The GitHub repo togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks gathers 32 prompts aimed at more than 26 models, including full system prompts, persona locks, workspace policies, AGENTS.md files and Ollama Modelfiles, each meant to be complete and paste-ready rather than excerpted. Coverage runs from free stealth models on OpenCode Zen and open-weight families like GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi and Qwen to closed models such as Claude, Gemini, Grok and Mistral. Aimed at people probing prompt boundaries and agent configuration.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
items.author: pbakaus
items.summary_zh: impeccable 是一套给 coding agent 用的设计词汇表：用 npx impeccable install 安装、在 agent 里运行 /impeccable init 之后，就能用 polish、bolder、critique、audit 等命令调整和审查界面产出，在代码上线前拦掉 AI 味的同质化设计。它支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI、GitHub Copilot、Gemini CLI 等十余种工具，适合在意 UI 质感的开发者。
items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design vocabulary for coding agents: install it with npx impeccable install, run /impeccable init inside your agent, and you get commands like polish, bolder, critique and audit to steer and review UI output, catching formulaic AI-generated design before it ships. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI and other tools, and targets developers who care about visual quality.

items.title: Apple's git still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates
items.author: galadran
items.summary_zh: Apple 在接到 eMudhra CA 被攻破的通知 11 天后，macOS 自带的 git、curl 和 python3 仍信任这批已失效的证书。也就是说，用系统自带工具拉代码或发起请求的开发者仍可能被中间人攻击，需要自己检查信任链并手动移除该根证书。
items.summary_en: Eleven days after Apple was notified that the eMudhra certificate authority had been compromised, the git, curl and python3 binaries shipped with macOS still trust the affected certificates. Anyone pulling code or making TLS connections with those system tools stays exposed to interception until the root is removed by hand, so macOS developers should check their trust store.

items.title: Genie 4
items.author: acossta
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4，官方定位是「新一代世界模拟」，能够生成并探索可交互的世界，并与 Gemini、Veo、Lyria 等模型并列在同一条产品线中。对做世界模型、游戏生成或具身智能仿真的研究者来说，这是继 SIMA 2 之后又一个可直接上手把玩的生成式环境。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind has introduced Genie 4, billed as a new generation of world simulation that generates interactive worlds users can explore. It sits in the same model lineup as Gemini, Veo and Lyria, alongside the earlier SIMA 2 agent work. Researchers working on world models, game generation or embodied-agent simulation are the obvious audience.

items.title: hmjz100/LinkSwift
items.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
items.author: hmjz100
items.summary_zh: LinkSwift 是一个改写自「网盘直链下载助手」的 JavaScript 工具，用来获取网盘文件的直链下载地址，覆盖百度网盘、阿里云盘、夸克网盘、123云盘等八家服务。README 提醒从 GreasyFork 安装的用户换用合适的源覆盖安装，以免脚本失效后无法及时更新。
items.summary_en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript userscript, forked from the "Wangpan Direct Download Helper," that pulls direct download links out of eight Chinese cloud drives including Baidu, Aliyun, Quark and 123. Its README warns people who installed it from GreasyFork to overwrite it from another source, so a broken script still gets updates.

items.title: 百家中资网贷出海印度亏损 70 亿退场，导致这一溃败的核心原因是什么？
items.summary_zh: 这是知乎上的一个提问：上百家中资网贷平台出海印度，累计亏损约 70 亿元后退场，问的是这场溃败的核心原因。原文只给出问题标题，未提供更多正文细节，因此具体平台名单与亏损口径都无法核实。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu question asks why roughly a hundred Chinese-funded online lending platforms lost about 7 billion yuan before pulling out of the Indian market. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available, so the specific lenders involved and how the loss figure was calculated can't be verified.

items.title: 比亚迪版劳斯莱斯，曝光了
items.summary_zh: 36氪 报道了一款被形容为「比亚迪版劳斯莱斯」的车型已经曝光。原文是链接，未提供更多细节，因此车辆的定位、售价与动力形式等信息无法确认。
items.summary_en: A 36Kr article reports that a BYD vehicle being described as a Rolls-Royce in BYD form has been revealed. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available, so the car's positioning, price and powertrain cannot be confirmed.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.author: obra
items.summary_zh: obra/superpowers 是一套面向 coding agent 的 skills 框架与软件开发方法论，由可组合的 Skill 加初始指令构成，用来确保 agent 会调用它们。README 给出了 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot CLI 等 CLI 的安装方式，适合想让写码助手按固定工程流程交付的开发者。
items.summary_en: obra/superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology built on composable skills plus initial instructions your agent is meant to follow. Its README documents setup for many coding tools, including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI. It targets developers who want their coding agent to follow a repeatable engineering process instead of improvising.

items.title: JetBrains/thinkrail
items.description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
items.author: JetBrains
items.summary_zh: ThinkRail 是 JetBrains 的孵化项目，一款 agentic IDE：它在 npm 包 @earendil-works/pi 提供的 pi 编码 agent 之上搭了完整界面，把任务隔离到独立 workspace，并用 living specs 与可复用 skills 让 agent 积累持久的项目知识。官方表示下一步将加入完整扩展支持，让它按你的实际工作方式生成所需工具。
items.summary_en: ThinkRail is a JetBrains incubator project: an agentic IDE built on the pi coding agent from the @earendil-works/pi npm package, wrapping it in a full interface, isolating each task in its own workspace, and giving the agent durable project knowledge through living specs and reusable skills. JetBrains says full extension support comes next, so the IDE can generate the tools it needs from how you actually work. It targets developers who want agents handling whole tasks rather than autocomplete.

items.title: nightly-labs/openbot
items.description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
items.author: nightly-labs
items.summary_zh: OpenBot 是 nightly-labs 的本地优先桌面工作区，让 Codex、Claude 等 agent 各有独立工作区和对话，并内置任务队列、文件传输、内嵌浏览器与 agent 间的消息通信。它通过 ACP 还能接入 Grok CLI、Gemini 等，适合同时管理多个编程 agent 的开发者；但目前仍是开发预览版，agent 默认拥有完整访问权限且不询问审批，只适合运行可信任务。
items.summary_en: OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace from nightly-labs that gives each AI agent its own workspace and conversation, plus task queues, file transfer, an embedded browser and agent-to-agent messaging. It runs the Codex App Server and Claude Code natively and adds Grok CLI, Gemini, Cursor CLI and others over ACP. It suits developers juggling several coding agents, but it's a dev preview where agents run with full access and no approval prompts.

items.title: 外交部回应姆巴佩道歉，「我们重视当事人作出的道歉」，姆巴佩事件的后续走向还有哪些可能性？
items.summary_zh: 围绕姆巴佩的道歉，中国外交部作出回应，表示「我们重视当事人作出的道歉」，知乎提问据此讨论事件后续还可能怎么走。原文只给出问题标题，未提供更多正文细节，道歉的具体背景与外交层面的后续动作都无法从现有材料确认。
items.summary_en: China's foreign ministry responded to an apology from Mbappé, saying it values the apology made by the person concerned, and a Zhihu thread asks where the episode could go next. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available, so the context of the apology and any diplomatic follow-up can't be confirmed.

items.title: 计算机领域天塌了，两大巨头同日宣布：世纪猜想ETH被证伪

ETH is a foundational assumption in complexity theory behind many results on how hard SAT and related problems are. The linked page isn't summarized here; the proof and its authors aren't available beyond the title.

items.title: 「酱油」一词为什么正在被「生抽」和「老抽」替代？
items.summary_zh: 这是一条知乎提问，问的是日常口语里「酱油」这个统称为什么越来越少，被「生抽」「老抽」这类按用途划分的品类词取代。问题牵扯到调味品命名、商品细分和各地用词习惯，适合对语言演变或食品行业感兴趣的人。素材里只有问题标题，没有回答内容。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu question asking why the generic word for soy sauce, jiangyou, is increasingly replaced in everyday speech by shengchou and laochou, the light and dark varieties sold as separate products. It touches on naming, product segmentation and regional usage. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: 微软要一刀裁掉大半个Meta，Copilot沦为重灾区
items.summary_zh: 36kr 这条报道的标题称，微软一轮裁员规模之大被形容为相当于砍掉大半个 Meta 的人头，Copilot 相关业务是受影响最重的部分。如果属实，这说明 AI 产品线在扩张之后也开始收缩。原文只提供链接，没有正文，具体人数和部门无法核实。

Read at face value, it points to a pullback in AI product orgs after a stretch of expansion. The linked page isn't summarized here; figures and affected teams aren't available beyond the title.

items.title: 如何评价秦朔发文《可怕的红果与中国互联网的字节时间》？
items.summary_zh: 知乎上这条提问请人评价秦朔的文章《可怕的红果与中国互联网的字节时间》，文章把红果这家公司和「字节时间」式的扩张节奏放在一起讨论。问题适合关注内容平台竞争与互联网公司节奏的人。素材中只有提问标题，没有正文或回答，文章的具体论点无法核实。

items.summary_en: A 36kr headline reports that an Anthropic experiment found 86% of top experts had key decisions steered by AI. If accurate, it bears on how persuasive models behave in high-stakes settings, and matters to anyone working on AI safety or putting models in advisory roles. The linked page isn't summarized here; the experiment's design and subjects aren't available beyond the title.

items.title: makecindy/cindy
items.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
items.author: makecindy
items.summary_zh: Cindy 是 makecindy 团队以 Apache-2.0 开源的个人 AI Agent，主打开箱即用：把工作电脑、家用台式机、笔记本和手机连到一起，接入你现有的模型和订阅，让它在自己的机器上实际干活。它同时强调可改造，用户能按自己的工作习惯定制这个助手，适合想自托管 Agent 又不想从零搭框架的开发者。
items.summary_en: Cindy is an Apache-2.0 open-source AI agent from makecindy that is meant to work out of the box. It links your work computer, home desktop, laptop and phone, uses the models and subscriptions you already pay for, and does real work on your own machines. It's aimed at developers who want a customizable, self-hosted agent without building the scaffolding themselves.
